mapper.select: SELECT s.salary_id, s.emp_id, e.ename AS employee_name, s.salary_year_month, s.base_salary, s.bonus, s.deduction, s.net_salary, s.payment_date FROM salary s LEFT JOIN emp e ON e.emp_id = s.emp_id ORDER BY s.salary_year_month DESC, s.salary_id DESC

SELECT s.salary_id, s.emp_id, e.ename AS employee_name, s.salary_year_month, s.base_salary, s.bonus, s.deduction, s.net_salary, s.payment_date FROM salary s LEFT JOIN emp e ON e.emp_id = s.emp_id WHERE s.salary_id = #{salaryId}
SELECT emp_id AS empId, ename AS employeeName FROM emp ORDER BY ename, emp_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO salary ( emp_id, salary_year_month, base_salary, bonus, deduction, net_salary, payment_date ) VALUES ( #{empId}, #{salaryYearMonth}, #{baseSalary}, #{bonus}, #{deduction}, #{netSalary}, #{paymentDate, jdbcType=DATE} )
